result.summary: Found 1 accessibility issue related to low color contrast on promotional banner text.

issues.description: In the top promotional banner, the text 'for you' has very low color contrast against the light green background, making it difficult to read clearly.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the color of the 'for you' text to match the dark gray of '3 free deliveries' or use a darker, high-contrast shade that stands out against the light green banner background to meet accessibility contrast standards.
